builder.name: Sara: first conversation (lead from Facebook group link)

situation.scenario: The learner speaks with Sara, who came in as a lead from: Facebook group link. Family relocating in the near term, kids 5 and 8. School commute and routine come first. Needs clarity on family-friendly communities. Budget 2.8–3.2M AED; timeline ≤ 60 days.
situation.hiddenTruth:
Held back until the learner earns it:
• Motivation: high
• What matters most: Time constraints 50%; Best price 30%; Market conditions 20%
• Constraints: school timings; quiet street; storage; avoid construction noise
• Areas: Arabian Ranches 2 / Tilal Al Ghaf (if justified)
situation.agreesWhen: The learner offers: questions about daily routine and commute; clear must-haves vs nice-to-haves.
situation.declinesWhen: The learner uses: pushing areas that don’t fit schools; pressure selling.

guardedIf: pushing areas that don’t fit schools
opensUpIf: questions about daily routine and commute
builder.whatToExpect: A first call with Sara (Relocating with kids), who came in from: Facebook group link. Earn the details before you pitch. Goal: book two viewings around school timings.
builder.opening: Hi, it's Sara, I found you through the Facebook group. We're moving in about two months and schools come first, so where would you even start?
exampleLines: Is there construction going on nearby?
We need proper storage, the kids have so much stuff.
I can only do viewings while the kids are at school.
learnerGoals: Book two viewings around school timings
